# Raaghu Design System (@waiin/raaghu-react)

> React 19 + MUI design system: about 110 exported components (elements, composite components, layouts, charts, AI chat UI) themed through `--rds-*` CSS variables with light and dark modes.

Import from the package root, wrap the app in `RaaghuThemeProvider` and import `@waiin/raaghu-react/styles.css`. Style only with `var(--rds-*)` tokens.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): usage, component selection guide, token and prop rules for contributors
- [docs/ai/components.json](docs/ai/components.json): every exported component with props, defaults and deprecations
- [docs/ai/tokens.json](docs/ai/tokens.json): every `--rds-*` variable with light and dark values
- [docs/TOKENS.md](docs/TOKENS.md): token reference table
- [docs/CSS_ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/CSS_ARCHITECTURE.md): SCSS structure, BEM naming, override order
- [docs/THEME_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md](docs/THEME_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md): theme provider and brand overrides
- [docs/COMPONENT_DEPRECATION_POLICY.md](docs/COMPONENT_DEPRECATION_POLICY.md): how props are renamed and removed

## Source

- [raaghu-elements/index.ts](raaghu-elements/index.ts): element exports
- [raaghu-components/index.ts](raaghu-components/index.ts): component exports
- [raaghu-layouts/index.ts](raaghu-layouts/index.ts): layout exports
- [raaghu-react-themes/tokens/design-tokens.ts](raaghu-react-themes/tokens/design-tokens.ts): raw token values
